entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (method). The assay reads steady-state abundance of a variant fused to EGFP, not an antibody signal: each cell expresses one variant, and mCherry is co-expressed as an expression control.
entries.snippet: Each cell expresses a single variant directly fused to EGFP. The stability of the variant dictates the abundance of the EGFP fusion and, accordingly, the green fluorescence signal of the cell. To control for expression, mCherry is either co-transcriptionally or co-translationally expressed.
entries.anchor: Results, Multiplex assessment of PTEN and TPMT variant abundance, paragraph 1

entries.proposition: The abundance read is made on an N-terminal EGFP fusion integrated at one genomic landing pad in HEK293T: a heterologous promoter and a non-neuronal cell, not the endogenous locus and not the cell type of the disease.
entries.snippet: Each wild type open reading frame was N-terminally tagged with EGFP and recombined into a single genomic locus of an engineered HEK 293T cell line17.

entries.proposition: Figure 2a read: the library, wild type and known destabilised variants separate on the EGFP:mCherry axis (PTEN WT peak near 300, the Y68H peak near 20; TPMT A80P near 15 and WT near 120, approximate by log-axis position), the four-bin gates are drawn; Figure 2b shows nonsense variants at about 0 and synonymous variants at about 1.
entries.snippet: We assessed the EGFP:mCherry ratio by flow cytometry, and found that cells expressing wild type PTEN or TPMT had ~5-fold higher EGFP:mCherry ratios than the known low-abundance variants (Fig. 2a; Supplementary Fig. 1b, c).

entries.proposition: Abundance scores are noisy at single-variant level and needed eight replicate sorts: replicate correlations are moderate.
entries.snippet: Abundance scores correlated modestly well between replicates (mean Pearson’s r = 0.63, mean Spearman’s ρ = 0.62 for PTEN; and mean r = 0.73, mean ρ = 0.67 for TPMT; Supplementary Fig. 2).

entries.proposition: Baseline stability sets how many missense variants lose abundance: a larger fraction of PTEN variants is low abundance than of TPMT, attributed to PTEN's lower thermostability. The equivalent baseline for a WWOX SDR domain is a missing measurement.
entries.snippet: A larger fraction of PTEN variants had low abundance scores than TPMT variants, possibly reflecting the lower thermostability of PTEN (Tm = 40.3 °C) relative to TPMT (Tm = ~60 °C) (Supplementary Fig 3f)20,21.

entries.snippet: In fact, as much as 75% of the pathogenic variation in monogenic disease is thought to disrupt thermodynamic stability and, consequently, alter abundance9,10.

entries.proposition: Limit stated by the authors: abundance cannot report variants that act through activity, localisation or splicing, and a WT-like score must not be read as benign.
entries.snippet: VAMP-seq cannot yield insight into variants that are pathogenic because of reduced enzymatic activity, altered localization, or effects on splicing.
